name: Vehicle 3 Tier Tax Law
description:
Required Bank Account: # Minister of Infrastructure Budget
Have three tiers of Vehicles placed defined in Section 2,5,6 reduced by section 7,8,9 per tier
Have two switches defined in Section 3,4

Tax Abandoned in Section 10, Active in Section 11
Tax on Active is layered on triggers - Tax only old vehilces (T1) on trigger T2, Tax all vehicles on trigger T3.
